patterns.note: A full-bleed hero image sets the stage, followed by a grid-based layout for services and project showcases, maintaining a clean and spacious feel.
The site uses a striking, oversized, rounded sans-serif for the main hero title, contrasting with a more traditional serif for body text and a clean sans-serif for navigation and labels.
A vibrant, warm orange (#ff5224) is used as a dominant accent and background color, providing energy and brand recognition, especially in the footer and sticky navigation.

The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image of plates scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating depth. The header transforms from transparent to a solid orange bar with a smaller logo and white text upon scrolling down.
The footer is a distinctive, full-width section featuring large-scale, whimsical white line-art illustrations of people dining and celebrating on a vibrant orange background.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a background image that moves at a different speed than the overlaying text content, creating a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls. This can be achieved using CSS transforms or JavaScript-based scroll libraries.

The site's header dynamically changes its appearance upon scroll: initially transparent over the hero, it transitions to a solid background color with adjusted text and logo sizing once the user scrolls past the hero section. This effect is typically managed with JavaScript event listeners that add/remove classes based on scroll position.

Given the detected GSAP animation tech, it's highly probable that content sections are revealed with scroll-triggered animations, such as elements fading or sliding into view as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, very bold, rounded display headings (~5x body) with a balanced mix of traditional serif for body text and clean sans-serif for labels and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and image cards, maintaining a soft but not overly playful edge.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a balanced density within content grids for readability and visual hierarchy.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its playful yet sophisticated brand identity, conveyed through the unique, oversized hero typography and the 'after-party' aesthetic of the hero image. This is further reinforced by the vibrant orange and the whimsical line-art illustrations in the footer, creating a memorable and celebratory feel for a food event agency.
